🌍 Global Exchange Program Launch

January 15, 2026
International Office
6 min read
🌍

Expanding Horizons with Global Exchange

We are thrilled to announce the launch of our expanded Global Exchange Program, offering students unprecedented opportunities to study abroad at prestigious universities across four continents. This initiative reflects our commitment to fostering global citizenship and cultural diversity.

Partner Universities

  • Europe: University of Cambridge (UK), ETH Zurich (Switzerland), Sorbonne University (France)
  • Asia: University of Tokyo (Japan), National University of Singapore (Singapore), University of Hong Kong
  • Americas: Harvard University (USA), University of Toronto (Canada)
  • Australia: University of Melbourne, ANU (Australian National University)

Program Duration

Students can opt for semester exchange (4-5 months) or year-long exchange programs. Regardless of duration, exchange students will earn credits that transfer back to our university, ensuring smooth progression toward their degrees.

Support & Benefits

The university provides accommodation subsidies, travel grants, and language support for exchange students. We also facilitate cultural orientation programs before departure and maintain mentorship throughout the exchange period. Students gain invaluable international experience while building a global network of friends and professionals.

Application Timeline

Applications for Fall 2026 exchange are now open through March 31, 2026. Candidates must maintain a minimum CGPA of 3.2 and demonstrate English proficiency. The final selection will be announced by May 15, 2026, giving students ample time to prepare for their international adventure.
